name: auto-handoff
description: Writes a handoff document when a session has sat idle long enough that its prompt cache is about to go cold.

minutes.title: Idle minutes
minutes.description: How long the session sits idle after its last turn before the command runs. The prompt cache lasts an hour, so 50 leaves ten minutes for the handoff itself.

command.title: Command
command.description: The slash command to run, as you would type it: its name, then any arguments. The default is the handoff skill this plugin ships; name your own to use it instead.
